Built for People Who Are
Done With the Games.

settings.editor: H2H Dating was born out of frustration. Our founders were tired of dating apps that charged $30/month just to see who liked them, buried profiles behind algorithms, and filled their matches with fake accounts.

So we built something different. H2H Dating — Heart to Heart — is America's only 100% free, AI-free, human-verified dating platform. Every profile is reviewed by a real person. Every feature is available at zero cost. No paywalls. No algorithms deciding your fate. Just real people, genuinely connecting.

image.alt: H2H Dating — building America's most genuine free dating platform

settings.editor: Every decision we make at H2H Dating comes back to one question: is this good for our members?
We tell you exactly what we are: free. No hidden fees, no bait-and-switch premium features, no surprise charges. Ever.
We manually verify every single profile. Real humans reviewing real people — because your safety and trust matter more than our convenience.
No bots. No catfishing. No scammers. Our human verification and community reporting keep H2H Dating a safe space for genuine connections.
Free isn't a promotion. It's our promise. H2H Dating will always be 100% free. That's not a tagline — it's the foundation our platform is built on.
Every great platform has an origin story. Ours started with a $29.99 monthly charge and a question: why should love cost this much?

Our founders, frustrated with yet another $29.99 monthly charge just to see who liked their profile, decided: enough. The idea for H2H Dating was born in a moment of genuine frustration — and a genuine desire to fix what was broken.

18 months of development, zero venture capital, and a simple mission: build the dating platform we always wanted but could never find. No investors telling us to add paywalls. No pressure to monetize trust.

H2H Dating launches publicly. 1,000 verified members in the first 30 days — all without spending a single dollar on paid advertising. Word of mouth from people who finally found what they were looking for.

Our first 1,000 couples connect through H2H. Every single one joined for free. Every single one used full features from day one. No paywall unlocks. No premium tiers. Just real people finding real connection.

Over 50,000 verified members trust H2H Dating. 12,000+ couples have found real connection here. We're still bootstrapped, still independent, and still 100% free — now and always. This is just the beginning.
Join 50,000+ verified Americans already using H2H Dating. It's completely free — now and always.
